name: Onna-musha
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 235 leadership · No mastery
pitch: A Heroic-era anti-cavalry pike line that braces against charges, sitting at C-tier — meta but very situational rather than a priority pick. Documentation is thin: the only build guidance on file is a single house veterancy screenshot from June 2023, well before the current balance state.

veterancy.label: Top branch
veterancy.body: Spend 3/3 → 2/2 → 3/3 → 3/3 → 2/2, leave the last two nodes unspent (0/3, 0/1). Captured from a level-24, 5-star veterancy screenshot — likely stale, predates the 2026-06-22 content cutoff by roughly three years.

veterancy.label: Bottom branch
veterancy.body: Spend 3/3 → 3/3 → 3/3, leave the last four nodes unspent (0/3, 0/1, 0/3, 0/1). Same source and same staleness caveat as the top branch — captured as one half of a single build, not a competing alternative.

gaps: No Amya guide exists for this unit — the tierlist row is the only Amya-sourced content (C tier, T4, no mastery).
No house card, video transcript, or battle-role/positioning/formation guidance found anywhere on disk — Battle role, Matchups, and Controls have zero source material.
Fight ratings (Blob/Flank/Skirmish/Duelling) not captured — Onna-musha is absent from unit-strengths.json.

The only veterancy build on file is a house screenshot from 21 June 2023 (~3 years stale) — balance patches since then may have changed the tree; treat as a rough starting point, not a current recommendation.
Confirmed NOT on the 13-unit [Chaos: A Realm Divided] (2026-06-25) balance-change list, so the stale veterancy build is at least not invalidated by that specific patch.
